headline: Copper Rises 2.08 Percent To $6.64 As Money Enters The Industrial Pipe
narrative: Copper rose 2.08 percent to $6.64, with money entering the industrial metals pipe. The S&P 500 rose 0.6 percent to 7,722.6, so the equity pipe took a bid with that industrial move, while gold rose 0.53 percent to $4,059.9 and silver rose 0.03 percent to $54.12. Oil fell 0.37 percent to $101.38, leaving the energy pipe offered as the industrial pipe drew the flow.
author: jordan
